_readme: Store catalogue. status: 'waitlist' (no price, no Product schema) | 'available' (requires price, preview, checkout_url; emits Product schema). checkout_url = hosted payment link from the APPROVED provider (Razorpay Payment Page, Cashfree, Instamojo, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Stripe Payment Link...). No SDK is hard-coded.
default_licence: Single-user personal licence. Schools/coaching institutes need a separate institutional licence.

global_edition._readme: Buy button for the Global Edition (@buy-global). It goes live only when checkout_url is a Lemon Squeezy /checkout/buy/ link AND site.json payment_flags.lemon_squeezy_store_enabled is true; otherwise the page shows a launch-notify button. Lemon Squeezy shows each buyer their local currency and tax.

india_edition._readme: Display tiers for the India Edition (@buy-india). The amount charged is resolved server-side by the payments Worker from assets/data/digital-catalog.json, never from the browser; keep these strings in step with it. Buttons go live only when site.json payments.api_base is set and mode is 'live'; otherwise a waitlist button. A tier with "hidden": true is not shown (add it to digital-catalog.json as well once its file is ready).
